name: Indian Railways ETA Prediction Pipeline
model_type: LightGBM Quantile Regressors (p08, p50, p92) + Severe Delay Classifier
leakage_audit_summary: An earlier development version of this model showed artificially inflated accuracy (12.68 min MAE) due to a target leakage bug where total event_duration was derived from simulated_delay_min. Following a 4-step audit, the target leakage was eliminated by replacing event_duration with realistic partial observability features (event_elapsed_min + event_expected_min dispatcher prior). The verified, honest non-capped MAE is 24.90 minutes.

confidence_accuracy_mapping.Medium: Expected error 13.1 to 21.6 min | ~45% within +-10 min
confidence_accuracy_mapping.Low: Expected error > 21.6 min or chronic/unseen train | High uncertainty
